name: Decisions right within a call cap
purpose: A draft decision is right more often after the check than before, within the declared number of model calls, and a decision the checks cannot settle is an abstain rather than a guess.
record: Twenty-one invented, neutral cases (evaluation/decision_check/build_cases.py): picks among options where the views hold the deciding evidence, the draft is right or wrong, the views split or agree on a wrong pick, and the evidence does not decide; and replies with a claim the executed actions or the reads contradict, with a clean reply, and with a statement that only looks wrong. One number: the share of decisions right; beside it the wrong decisions, the calls per decision and the share the views agreed on. The learning loop is judged here too: a known-mistake line is adopted only when this number rises on held-out cases, and retired when removing it does not lower it.
disadvantages: Invented cases show the failure kinds, not their frequency; the model-free floor is the only arm recorded offline, and the model-calling arms are measured by the consumer on its own labelled decisions with a model of the cheap tier.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the model-free floor was recorded on the cases] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end through a model-calling arm and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run decision_check --impl draft_as_given; esoi run decision_check --impl agreement_check --max-calls 100; esoi run decision_check --impl single_verify --max-calls 50
